measured_from: example figures shipped with the public release; they are not a measurement of any machine and are not enforced while measured is false
sampler: none: write this file from the peaks of a job run under measurement on your own machine
why_the_floor_is_the_peak_with_no_margin: A safety multiplier would be a guess. A measured floor is the largest value a real run actually reached, and a job of the same class needs at least that much.
single_observation: Replace these example figures with the peaks of real runs on the machine that will do the work; the right correction when a job fails above a floor is another measurement rather than a larger constant.

totals.what_the_headroom_means: not measured in the public release

what_a_floor_is_for: Once measured, a job is refused before it starts when free resources are below these floors.
